description.value: The Nanoose Bay Cafe Coffee Shop is a marina-side morning destination at Schooner Cove, serving locally-roasted French Press Coffee Roasters beans alongside house-made light fare and artisan goods from the on-site Marketplace. It is the coffee-focused daytime arm of a larger full-service restaurant and bar operation that also offers brunch, lunch, happy hour, and dinner. The work-friendly setup — with power outlets at nearly every seat and a Kids' Corner — makes it a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through the Parksville–Nanaimo corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating marina-side coffee shop at Schooner Cove, part of the larger Nanoose Bay Cafe restaurant and bar complex. Phone (+1 (250) 468-0780) and address (3521 Dolphin Dr, Nanoose Bay, BC V9P 9K1) both match OSM tags. The website explicitly states 'TAKE-OUT OR DINE-IN,' 'power outlets at nearly every seat,' and menus are liberally labeled 'VG GF' throughout; OSM toilets=yes is consistent with a full-service restaurant venue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible cafe and restaurant at a marina on Vancouver Island, with confirmed contact details and active website. A useful stop for touring cyclists on the Parksville–Nanaimo corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM record links specifically to the coffee shop sub-page; the broader establishment is 'Nanoose Bay Cafe Restaurant & Bar' with a full lunch, dinner, and happy hour program. The coffee shop portion operates mornings only, but the full venue is open daily through the evening.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items throughout all pages are labeled 'VG GF' (vegan and gluten-free options); includes items such as Korean Fried Cauliflower, Chickpea Hummus, Buffalo Cauliflower Wrap, and Fried Eggplant

Device charging.detail: Website states: 'We've got power outlets at nearly every seat.'
